metro_engine.name: METRo
metro_engine.initialization: 1–2h measured road surface history, interpolated to 30s; no subsurface observations or >=3h radiation coupling
metro_engine.road_layers: assumed 0.18m asphalt, 0.30m crushed rock, 1.12m sand + upstream deep sand
metro_engine.precipitation_phase: estimated: snow when air <=0C and precipitation >0; otherwise liquid; no drizzle discrimination
metro_engine.solid_reservoir: combined snow/ice; IJS/SN means solid type unknown
metro_engine.runner_changes: initial liquid water injection from same scenarios as RoadSurf; output memory release; Fortran physics unmodified
